routineText:
-----------------------
| 🌅 Breakfast
| — whole wheat bread 100g
| — oat (a little) + a little milk
| — 1 banana
| — mint tea (2 cups) + 2 tsp sugar
-----------------------

-----------------------
| ☀️ Lunch
| — minced meat (kefta) 250g
| — legume, as always (sauté: carrot / courgette / onion)
| — olive oil 20g raw + 10g cooking
| — cumin & salt
-----------------------

-----------------------
| 🌙 Dinner
| — 3 scoops of protein powder
| — 250g raib (homemade, from Jaouda Sans Lactose)
| — nuts, 5g of each: almonds, walnuts, cashews, pistachios, pumpkin seeds
-----------------------

💧 Water — 3L across the day
